integrity: An analytical finite-dimensional trigonometric proof with a separately executable finite numerical corroboration; no automated or third-party proof certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two equal-radius, half-step-staggered regular polygonal bases with positive height. Originality historically provisional; the accessible 2023 uniform-antiprism paper is partially previewed, and possible equivalent historical formulations remain a residual risk.
title: Equidihedral minimax and volume–angle separation in regular antiprisms
